newsitem.title: CHINA: Tientsin Marine to list A shares.
newsitem.headline: Tientsin Marine to list A shares.

text.p: Tientsin Marine Shipping will list 34.64 million A shares on September 9 on the Shanghai Stock Exchange, a company statement said on Wednesday.
The 34.64 million A shares, that were issued as shares to employees in 1992, account for 14.87 percent of the company's total shares, it said.

After listing the A shares, Tientsin Marine will have a total of 233 million outstanding shares, including 90.684 million state-owned shares, 12.4355 million held by institutions, 5.2405 million held by employees and 90 million foreign currency B shares, the company statement said.
Tientsin Marine, which operates container services from China to east Asian ports, posted 51.144 million yuan net profit in the first half of 1996, up 110 percent from the same 1995 period.
